_about: Format of the hand-made list behind the pro page's managers box and 'Learn from the pro' videos (apps/api/app/services/pro_extras.py). This sample is made up. The real list is about real people, so keep it outside the repository and point PRO_EXTRAS_FILE at it. Key each player by 'footystats:<FootyStats player id>' or 'player:<NorthStar player id>'. A video is an official YouTube video: 'youtube' is the 11 character id after watch?v= in its link.
